org_ref.description: Lyft, Inc. is an American corporation providing ride-hailing, e-scooter, and bike-sharing services across the U.S. and Canada. The company aims to improve urban mobility, reduce personal car ownership, and connect communities through its multimodal transportation network.

job_ref.title: Social Impact Coordinator
